{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine merino sweater, fitted crew neck, hip length, long sleeves, emerald green #0B6B4F, extra-fine merino wool
Pleated midi skirt, A-line, mid-calf length, burgundy #7A1F36, wool crepe
Opaque tights, 60 denier, black #1A1A1A, matte knit
Single-breasted coat, tailored fit, knee length, camel #C19A6B, soft brushed wool
Ankle boots, almond toe, 5 cm block heel, cognac #8B4A2B, smooth leather
Silk scarf, square, loosely knotted at the neck, gold and emerald print on a cream ground #E8DCC0, twill silk
Drop earrings, small and sculptural, warm gold #C9A24B, brushed metal
Structured top-handle bag, medium size, black #1C1C1C, grained leather

Emerald and burgundy side by side make a rich, confident colour pairing, so you will stand out in the pews without anything flashy. The mid-calf skirt, long sleeves and closed neckline keep the look respectful for a church service. The same outfit also suits a relaxed lunch with your parents afterwards. The camel coat and cognac boots add warmth for an autumn day, and the silk scarf and gold earrings give a polished finish."}
